# VIES VAT Validator MCP

> Two-stage EU VAT validation: free offline format pre-check, then live VIES, with bilingual error codes.

Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) that validates EU VAT numbers against the official free VIES SOAP API. Stage 1 is a free offline format pre-check backed by a free TTL cache; stage 2 is an optional live VIES query. Results are structured and bilingual (中文/EN) with explainable error codes — an outage is never reported as "invalid".

Built for cross-border e-commerce, trade finance and KYB/compliance workflows. Covers EU 27 + GB + XI. GB and XI are honestly reported as outside VIES scope post-Brexit (pointing to HMRC / the XI portal) instead of a false "invalid".

## Endpoint

- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://neeenja--vies-vat-validator-mcp.apify.actor/mcp
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`

## Tools

| Tool | Price | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `validate_vat` | $0.0005 / event (rising to $0.005 from 2026-11-06) | Live VIES check, free local format pre-check first |
| `check_vat_format` | free | Pure local regex format check, no network |
| `list_supported_countries` | free | Supported countries with native names + local VAT terms |
| `get_error_codes` | free | Full bilingual error-code table |
